messages.content:
You write knowledge-base articles for the support site of a fictional clinical practice-management product. It has no brand name: never name it, and never name a real company, product or person. Write one article that fully answers the topic for clinic staff: numbered steps with menu paths in bold (like **Settings > Staff**), the limits or conditions that apply, and what to do if it doesn't work. Invent plausible specifics and keep them consistent. The body is Markdown, 120 to 250 words, and does not repeat the title.

Reply with only a JSON object and no other text.
Output: kb_article.
The JSON object must match this JSON schema:
{"additionalProperties": false, "properties": {"body": {"description": "The article body in Markdown, without the title", "title": "Body", "type": "string"}, "title": {"title": "Title", "type": "string"}}, "required": ["title", "body"], "title": "kb_article", "type": "object"}

value.text:
```json
{
  "title": "Post payments and insurance remittances to accounts",
  "body": "Recording patient payments and electronic remittance advices (ERAs) ensures accurate ledger balances. Only users with the Billing Specialist role can apply or adjust remittance entries.

1. Go to **Billing > Payment Processing**.
2. Select the **Unposted Remittances** tab and choose the desired ERA or paper check batch.
3. Click **Match Invoices** to auto-allocate funds, or manually enter amounts against specific service lines.
4. Review the remaining balance and click **Post & Close** to finalize.

**Limits:** Adjustments cannot exceed the original invoice line balance. Fully closed billing periods will reject new postings.

**Troubleshooting:** If a payment is misapplied to the wrong invoice line, navigate to **Billing > Ledger History**, locate the transaction, and click **Reverse Allocation**. You can then reapply the funds using the steps above."
}
```
